title: Bottle gourd Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Bottle gourd Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fertilizer Fix
metaDescription: Bottle gourd nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen and potassium in upo, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Bottle gourd nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your upo (bottle gourd) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus, magnesium, calcium and boron. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

heroImage.alt: Bottle gourd leaf turned pale yellow green from nitrogen shortage
heroImage.credit: Orka, Uddin, Toushique and Hossain, OLID I dataset, CC BY 4.0, via Zenodo

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But calcium and boron stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which bottle gourd nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a bottle gourd nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest bottle gourd nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in bottle gourd

blocks.alt: Bottle gourd leaf turned pale yellow green from nitrogen shortage
blocks.caption: Photo: Orka, Uddin, Toushique and Hossain, OLID I dataset, CC BY 4.0, via Zenodo

blocks.text: Older leaves turn pale to light green and the yellowing spreads up the shoot. Vines are stunted, fruits are pale and small, and yield drops. You see it most at this stage: vine growth and fruiting.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in upo
Sandy soils, heavy rain, low organic matter, and no side dressing during fruiting.
How to tell it apart
Magnesium shortage keeps the veins green on old leaves. To be sure, old leaves yellow first. Soil test and leaf tissue test.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency
Side dress urea based on the soil test. For a quick fix, give a urea leaf spray at 10 grams per liter of water every 15 days.

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, add manure in the hills and side dress during fruiting.
Potassium deficiency in bottle gourd

Older leaves yellow and scorch, cup and curl upward, with dead spots along the midrib. Shoots die back, stems are weak and fewer female flowers form. You see it most at this stage: flowering and fruiting.
Why potassium deficiency happens in upo
Sandy or acid soils, heavy rain, and fertilizing with urea only.
How to tell it apart
Magnesium shortage yellows between the veins first. To be sure, soil test for potassium and a leaf tissue test.
What to apply for potassium deficiency

Apply muriate of potash based on the soil test, in split doses. For immediate relief, give a morning spray of sulfate of potash at 10 grams per liter of water with a sticker. Keep pH above 6 with lime or dolomite.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, include potash at planting and at flowering.
Phosphorus deficiency in bottle gourd
Leaves turn purplish, especially along the veins. Shoots are short and thin, leaves dull, and vigour and yield are poor. You see it most at this stage: early vine growth.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in upo
Acid or iron rich soils, low organic matter, and no phosphorus at planting.
How to tell it apart
Root knot nematodes also stunt vines. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus and pH.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency
Apply phosphorus in the hill based on the soil test. Use single superphosphate for a quick fix. Uptake is best near pH 6.2 to 7.0.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use complete fertilizer or 16 20 0 in the hill at planting.
Magnesium deficiency in bottle gourd

The middle of mature leaves turns yellow while the edges stay green, with yellowing between the veins and spotted dead patches. Leaves drop early and yield falls. You see it most at this stage: fruiting.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in upo
Sandy acid soils, dry spells, and heavy potash or ammonium fertilizer.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen shortage yellows the whole leaf. To be sure, soil test for magnesium, potassium and pH.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency

Try magnesium sulfate in a band near the plants at about 80 kg per hectare (32 kg per acre). Do not apply it with potash. The University of Kentucky notes leaf sprays alone rarely fix a serious shortage in cucurbits.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **YaraTera KRISTA MgS** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (16 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur), **Magnepro** by Ramgo International Corporation (16 percent MgO and 12.8 percent sulfur) and **Lucky Planters Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salt)** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (16.27 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use dolomite on acid soil.
Calcium deficiency in bottle gourd

Young leaves show yellow stripes along the midrib, crinkle, curl and yellow at the edges. Growing tips die back, roots are stunted, and fruit set is poor or fails. Fruits can rot at the blossom end, as in other cucurbits. You see it most at this stage: vine growth and early fruiting, in dry spells.
Why calcium deficiency happens in upo
Very acid soils, uneven watering, excess phosphorus and low boron.
How to tell it apart
Boron shortage also deforms new growth and drops fruit. To be sure, soil test for calcium, pH and boron.
What to apply for calcium deficiency
Try lime at about 250 kg per hectare when soil pH is 5.5 to 6, or about 840 kg per hectare in two doses when pH is 3.5 to 4.5. Gypsum on soil that is not acid. Water evenly.

Sold here with calcium: **Planters Products Lifelime** by Planters Products, Inc. (50.59 percent CaO), **Macrock Limestone** by Donumdei 1 Corp. (36 to 42 percent calcium), **Calcic Lime** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (35.52 percent calcium) and **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [fertilizer for tomatoes](/blog/fertilizer-for-tomatoes), and the page on [calcium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/calcium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, lime acid soil before planting and keep watering steady.
Boron deficiency in bottle gourd

New leaves are malformed and the plant grows stunted and bushy. Young fruits drop or abort, and fruits show corky marks on the skin, crack, and stay small and light. You see it most at this stage: flowering and fruit set.
Why boron deficiency happens in upo
Sandy soils, overlimed soils, low organic matter and drought.
How to tell it apart
Fruit fly damage also drops fruits, but leaves stay normal and maggots are found inside. To be sure, soil test for boron and a leaf tissue test.
What to apply for boron deficiency
Try borax in the soil at about 10 kg per hectare (4 kg per acre) or a borax spray at 1 gram per liter of water. Do not mix borax with calcium or ammonium fertilizers.

Sold here with boron: **Solubor** by Caldic Philippines Inc. (21 percent boron), **Etifert 11 (Borax Decahydrate)** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (11 percent boron), **YaraVita BORTRAC 150** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (11.1 percent boron) and **Grow More Liquid Chelate Boron** by Sagrex Corporation (10 percent boron). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [boron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/boron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, add a small boron dose to the basal fertilizer on sandy fields.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any bottle gourd nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your upo needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Bottle gourd nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my upo leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: older leaves pale and yellowing up the vine, with small, pale fruits. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at magnesium deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in bottle gourd?
items.a: Side dress urea based on the soil test. For a quick fix, give a urea leaf spray at 10 grams per liter of water every 15 days.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in bottle gourd?
items.a: Apply muriate of potash based on the soil test, in split doses. For immediate relief, give a morning spray of sulfate of potash at 10 grams per liter of water with a sticker.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in bottle gourd?
items.a: Apply phosphorus in the hill based on the soil test. Use single superphosphate for a quick fix.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my upo lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the bottle gourd nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
